test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 12 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Three statements are given followed by two conclusions. Consider the statements and conclusions to be true even if they vary from commonly known facts and then decide which of the conclusions follow(s) from the given statements.

**Statements:**

1. All squares are roses.

2 . Some roses are parrots.

3. No parrot is a square.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some parrots are roses.

II. Some squares are parrots.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow.

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1fa83c5d6a2d2070a61a6e8be92311bef1f7ca92fcaa2d9290260c7521a8986a.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some parrots are roses → Follow (As some roses are parrots. As some part of roses is common with parrots, therefore it is true.)

II. Some squares are parrots → Does not follow (As no parrot is a square. So it is possible but not definite.)

∴ Here, Only conclusion I follows.

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
